poses.caption: Hold a gentle crunch with hands supporting head and straight legs hovering low
Cross the right straight leg over the left while keeping lower back grounded
Uncross and cross the left leg over the right, maintaining the gentle crunch

jobs.detail: LYING SCISSOR CRUNCH, THREE equal panels. Elevated FRONT THREE-QUARTER view from foot end shows BOTH legs and their crossing clearly, same camera/model. Lie supine on white floor, HANDS BEHIND HEAD lightly supporting skull, elbows OPEN out to sides; gently curl SHOULDER BLADES up, chin neutral away from chest, eyes toward feet, no pulling neck. Lower back/pelvis stay grounded. BOTH legs STRAIGHT and hover a few inches above floor through ALL phases. Panel1 legs uncrossed open a little apart, shoulder crunch held. Panel2 RIGHT leg crosses horizontally OVER LEFT at lower shin/ankle, both legs stay LOW above floor, overlap visible like shallow X; no bicycling or high vertical leg split. Panel3 uncross then LEFT leg crosses OVER RIGHT, same shallow X opposite top leg. Preserve clear right/left identity, equal unchanged lengths, both knees straight, no foot touching floor. Same stable shoulder crunch and hands-behind-head throughout. Primary ABS only ONE soft DIFFUSE BLURRED RED COLOR PATCH over intact BLACK abdomen shirt fabric, no visible abs segments/lines/fibers through shirt; torso fully opaque front/sides/back. Black shorts wrap full front/sides/back/seat/crotch during crossing. Exposed limbs detailed grayscale, no red legs. Entire body, all fingers/elbows/shoes fully inside each panel with white margins.

jobs.detail: LYING SIMULTANEOUS ALTERNATING LEG RAISE, TWO opposing leg positions. Elevated FRONT three-quarter view from foot end shows each leg identity clearly, same camera. Lie SUPINE on white floor, HEAD/SKULL relaxed ON floor looking upward, neck neutral, shoulder blades and LOWER BACK/Pelvis grounded. BOTH ARMS lie straight alongside torso on FLOOR, palms down, hands beside hips NOT underneath hips. Both legs mostly STRAIGHT with soft knees. LEFT panel RIGHT leg raises toward ceiling about70degrees from hips, LEFT leg hovers low10cm above floor. RIGHT panel simultaneously SWITCH legs: RIGHT leg lowers to hover10cm above floor, LEFT leg raises70degrees. BOTH knees remain straight; no bicycling, no horizontal crossing, no hip lifting or lumbar arch, no bent elbow/head crunch. Keep actual left/right thigh identity and lengths unchanged; the leg closer viewer must change high/low between phases, not repeat identical silhouette. Primary ABS only ONE faint soft DIFFUSE BLURRED RED COLOR PATCH printed on intact OPAQUE BLACK abdominal shirt fabric; no six-pack outlines, fibers, cutaways or internal muscle boundaries in cloth. Shorts black full seat/crotch/front/sides/rear coverage, limbs exposed fine grayscale. Entire person both hands/head/shoes within each panel with spacious white margins.
